spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "Total",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE wraparound) AS "Anti-wraparound"
FROM pganalyze.vacuum_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)

spec.title: Transaction ID Utilization
spec.description: How much transaction ID space is utilized among the actual maximum available transaction IDs, in percent.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * age(datfrozenxid) / 4294967296, 4) AS xid_utilization_percent
FROM pg_database
WHERE datname = current_database()

SELECT
    n.nspname || '.' || c.relname AS "Table",
    COUNT(*) AS "Count",
    SUM(v.tuples_removed) || ' (' ||
    ROUND(
        SUM(v.tuples_removed)
        / NULLIF(SUM(v.tuples_removed + v.tuples_remain), 0) * 100.0,
        2
    ) || '%)' AS "Tuples removed",
    SUM(v.index_scans) AS "Index scans",
    SUM(v.pages_removed) AS "Pages removed",
    MAX(v.finished_at - v.started_at) AS "Max duration",
    MAX(v.finished_at) AS "Last vacuum"
FROM pganalyze.vacuum_stats v
JOIN pg_class c
    ON c.oid = v.hypertable_relid
JOIN pg_namespace n
    ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
GROUP BY
    v.hypertable_relid,
    n.nspname,
    c.relname
ORDER BY SUM(v.tuples_removed) DESC

spec.title: Xmin Horizon Assigned
spec.description: How long ago the xmin horizon was assigned, indicating up to which point VACUUM can clean up dead rows.

spec.rawSql:
WITH xmin_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE((
      SELECT
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(pg_catalog.age(backend_xid), 0) > COALESCE(pg_catalog.age(backend_xmin), 0)
          THEN backend_xid::text::bigint
          ELSE backend_xmin::text::bigint
        END
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_activity
      WHERE backend_xmin IS NOT NULL OR backend_xid IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY greatest(pg_catalog.age(backend_xmin), pg_catalog.age(backend_xid)) DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ), 0) AS backend,

    COALESCE((
      SELECT xmin::text::bigint
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_replication_slots
      WHERE xmin IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY pg_catalog.age(xmin) DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ), 0) AS replication_slot_xmin,

    COALESCE((
      SELECT catalog_xmin::text::bigint
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_replication_slots
      WHERE catalog_xmin IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY pg_catalog.age(catalog_xmin) DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ), 0) AS replication_slot_catalog_xmin,

    COALESCE((
      SELECT transaction::text::bigint
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_prepared_xacts
      ORDER BY pg_catalog.age(transaction) DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ), 0) AS prepare_xact,

    COALESCE((
      SELECT backend_xmin::text::bigint
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_replication
      WHERE backend_xmin IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY pg_catalog.age(backend_xmin) DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ), 0) AS standby
),
true_xmin AS (
  SELECT
    LEAST(
      backend,
      replication_slot_xmin,
      replication_slot_catalog_xmin,
      prepare_xact,
      standby
    ) AS xmin
  FROM xmin_candidates
),
txn_rate AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (now() - COALESCE(stats_reset, pg_postmaster_start_time()))) AS seconds_since_startup,
    (xact_commit + xact_rollback) AS total_txns,
    CASE 
      WHEN (xact_commit + xact_rollback) > 0
      THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM (now() - COALESCE(stats_reset, pg_postmaster_start_time()))) / (xact_commit + xact_rollback)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS seconds_per_txn
  FROM pg_stat_database
  WHERE datname = current_database()
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN seconds_per_txn IS NOT NULL
       THEN (txid_current() - xmin) * seconds_per_txn
       ELSE NULL
  END AS approx_seconds_ago
FROM true_xmin CROSS JOIN txn_rate;

WITH threshold AS (
  SELECT setting::bigint AS "autovacuum_freeze_max_age"
  FROM pg_settings
  WHERE name ='autovacuum_freeze_max_age'
)

SELECT
  collected_at AS time,
  frozen_xid_age,
  (SELECT autovacuum_freeze_max_age FROM threshold) AS autovacuum_freeze_max_age
FROM pganalyze.database_stats
ORDER BY collected_at

WITH threshold AS (
  SELECT setting::bigint AS "autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age"
  FROM pg_settings
  WHERE name ='autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age'
)

SELECT
  collected_at AS time,
  frozen_mxid_age,
  (SELECT autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age FROM threshold) AS autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age
FROM pganalyze.database_stats
ORDER BY collected_at

spec.title: Max read I/O impact
spec.description: Theoretical maximum impact that VACUUM can have on your system

spec.rawSql:
WITH settings AS (
  SELECT
    (CASE 
       WHEN (SELECT setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit') = '-1'
       THEN (SELECT setting::numeric FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'vacuum_cost_limit')
       ELSE (SELECT setting::numeric FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit')
     END) AS vacuum_cost_limit_effective,
    (SELECT setting::numeric FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'vacuum_cost_page_miss') AS vacuum_cost_page_miss,
    (SELECT setting::numeric FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay') AS autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay,
    8192 AS block_size_bytes -- 8kB block size
)
SELECT
  (vacuum_cost_limit_effective / vacuum_cost_page_miss * block_size_bytes / autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay) * 1000 AS max_vacuum_read_rate_bytes_per_sec
FROM settings

spec.title: Max write I/O impact
spec.description: Theoretical maximum impact that VACUUM can have on your system

spec.rawSql:
WITH settings AS (
  SELECT
    (CASE 
       WHEN (SELECT setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit') = '-1'
       THEN (SELECT setting::numeric FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'vacuum_cost_limit')
       ELSE (SELECT setting::numeric FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit')
     END) AS vacuum_cost_limit_effective,
    (SELECT setting::numeric FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'vacuum_cost_page_dirty') AS vacuum_cost_page_dirty,
    (SELECT setting::numeric FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay') AS autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay,
    8192 AS block_size_bytes -- 8kB block size
)
SELECT
  (vacuum_cost_limit_effective / vacuum_cost_page_dirty * block_size_bytes / autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay) * 1000 AS max_vacuum_write_rate_bytes_per_sec
FROM settings

spec.title: Est. Table Bloat
spec.description: The estimated overall table bloat on this server or database - this is a very rough estimate and should be reviewed for individual tables. Compressed chunks are excluded and only tables > 1MB are considered.

spec.rawSql:
WITH compressed_chunks AS (
    SELECT
        chunk_schema,
        chunk_name
    FROM timescaledb_information.chunks
    WHERE is_compressed = true
),
tables AS (
    SELECT
        p.schemaname,
        p.tablename
    FROM pg_tables p
    WHERE p.schemaname NOT SIMILAR TO '(pg_catalog|information_schema%)'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM compressed_chunks c
          WHERE c.chunk_schema = p.schemaname
            AND c.chunk_name = p.tablename
      )
),
bloat_data AS (
    SELECT
        stats.table_len,
        stats.dead_tuple_len::numeric AS bloat_bytes
    FROM tables t
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL pgstattuple_approx(
        format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename)
    ) stats
    WHERE stats.table_len >= 1048576  -- 1 MB minimum
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(bloat_bytes), 0) AS total_bloat_bytes,
    COALESCE(
        ROUND(
            100.0 * SUM(bloat_bytes)
            / NULLIF(SUM(table_len), 0),
            2
        ),
        0
    ) AS bloat_percent
FROM bloat_data

spec.title: Total tables
spec.description: The total number of tables on this database - databases with a lot of tables can often times suffer from more autovacuum scheduling challenges.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_tables
FROM pg_class c

SELECT
    name,
    setting
  FROM pg_settings
  WHERE name IN (
    'autovacuum_max_workers',
    'autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay',
    'autovacuum_vacuum_threshold',
    'autovacuum_freeze_max_age',
    'autovacuum_vacuum_insert_threshold',
    'autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit',
    'autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor',
    'autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age',
    'autovacuum_vacuum_insert_scale_factor',
    'autovacuum_naptime',
    'autovacuum_work_mem'
  )

spec.title: Table bloat info
spec.description: Per-table bloat estimates, as calculated by the difference of the actual table size, compared to the average row size * number of rows in the table. For hypertables we only consider uncompressed chunks

spec.rawSql:
WITH constants AS (
  SELECT
    current_setting('block_size') :: numeric AS block_size,
    8 :: numeric AS maxalign,
    24 :: numeric AS page_header,
    23 :: numeric AS tuple_header,
    4 :: numeric AS item_pointer
),
/*
 * Column statistics used to estimate the physical row width.
 */
column_stats AS (
  SELECT
    s.schemaname AS schema,
    s.tablename AS tbl,
    SUM(
      (1.0 - COALESCE(s.null_frac, 0)) * COALESCE(s.avg_width, 0)
    ) :: numeric AS avg_data_width,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE
        s.null_frac > 0
    ) AS nullable_columns
  FROM
    pg_stats s
  WHERE
    s.schemaname NOT SIMILAR TO '(pg_catalog|information_schema|_timescaledb%)'
    AND s.inherited = false
  GROUP BY
    s.schemaname,
    s.tablename
),
/*
 * Effective per-table autovacuum settings.
 */
table_options AS (
  SELECT
    c.oid,
    n.nspname AS schema,
    c.relname AS tbl,
    COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT
          option_value :: numeric
        FROM
          pg_options_to_table(c.reloptions)
        WHERE
          option_name = 'autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor'
      ),
      current_setting(
        'autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor'
      ) :: numeric
    ) AS vacuum_scale_factor,
    COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT
          option_value :: numeric
        FROM
          pg_options_to_table(c.reloptions)
        WHERE
          option_name = 'autovacuum_vacuum_threshold'
      ),
      current_setting(
        'autovacuum_vacuum_threshold'
      ) :: numeric
    ) AS vacuum_threshold,
    c.reltuples :: numeric AS row_count,
    pg_relation_size(c.oid) :: numeric AS actual_heap_bytes,
    COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT
          option_value :: numeric
        FROM
          pg_options_to_table(c.reloptions)
        WHERE
          option_name = 'fillfactor'
      ),
      100
    ) AS fillfactor
  FROM
    pg_class c
    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  WHERE
    c.relkind = 'r'
    AND n.nspname NOT SIMILAR TO '(pg_catalog|information_schema|_timescaledb%)'
),
/*
 * Normal PostgreSQL tables.
 */
normal_estimates AS (
  SELECT
    o.schema,
    o.tbl,
    o.row_count,
    o.actual_heap_bytes,
    o.vacuum_scale_factor,
    o.vacuum_threshold,
    o.fillfactor,
    CEIL(
      o.row_count / GREATEST(
        1,
        FLOOR(
          (
            k.block_size - k.page_header
          ) * (o.fillfactor / 100.0) / NULLIF(
            (
              k.item_pointer + k.tuple_header + CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(cs.nullable_columns, 0) > 0 THEN CEIL(
                  (cs.nullable_columns + 7) / 8.0
                )
                ELSE 0
              END + COALESCE(cs.avg_data_width, 0) + k.maxalign - (
                (
                  k.item_pointer + k.tuple_header + CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(cs.nullable_columns, 0) > 0 THEN CEIL(
                      (cs.nullable_columns + 7) / 8.0
                    )
                    ELSE 0
                  END + COALESCE(cs.avg_data_width, 0)
                ) % k.maxalign
              )
            ),
            1
          )
        )
      )
    ) * k.block_size AS estimated_ideal_bytes
  FROM
    table_options o
    CROSS JOIN constants k
    LEFT JOIN column_stats cs ON cs.schema = o.schema
    AND cs.tbl = o.tbl
  WHERE
    o.actual_heap_bytes >= 1048576
),
/*
 * TimescaleDB uncompressed chunks.
 */
chunk_data AS (
  SELECT
    ch.hypertable_schema AS schema,
    ch.hypertable_name AS tbl,
    ch.chunk_schema,
    ch.chunk_name,
    c.oid,
    c.reltuples :: numeric AS row_count,
    pg_relation_size(c.oid) :: numeric AS actual_heap_bytes,
    COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT
          option_value :: numeric
        FROM
          pg_options_to_table(c.reloptions)
        WHERE
          option_name = 'autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor'
      ),
      current_setting(
        'autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor'
      ) :: numeric
    ) AS vacuum_scale_factor,
    COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT
          option_value :: numeric
        FROM
          pg_options_to_table(c.reloptions)
        WHERE
          option_name = 'autovacuum_vacuum_threshold'
      ),
      current_setting(
        'autovacuum_vacuum_threshold'
      ) :: numeric
    ) AS vacuum_threshold,
    COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT
          option_value :: numeric
        FROM
          pg_options_to_table(c.reloptions)
        WHERE
          option_name = 'fillfactor'
      ),
      100
    ) AS fillfactor,
    st.last_autovacuum
  FROM
    timescaledb_information.chunks ch
    JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = format(
      '%I.%I',
      ch.chunk_schema,
      ch.chunk_name
    ) :: regclass
    LEFT JOIN pg_stat_user_tables st ON st.schemaname = ch.chunk_schema
    AND st.relname = ch.chunk_name
  WHERE
    ch.is_compressed = false
    AND pg_relation_size(c.oid) >= 1048576
),
chunk_estimates AS (
  SELECT
    cd.schema,
    cd.tbl,
    cd.row_count,
    cd.actual_heap_bytes,
    cd.vacuum_scale_factor,
    cd.vacuum_threshold,
    cd.last_autovacuum,
    CEIL(
      cd.row_count / GREATEST(
        1,
        FLOOR(
          (
            k.block_size - k.page_header
          ) * (cd.fillfactor / 100.0) / NULLIF(
            (
              k.item_pointer + k.tuple_header + COALESCE(
                CEIL(
                  (cs.nullable_columns + 7) / 8.0
                ),
                0
              ) + COALESCE(cs.avg_data_width, 0) + k.maxalign - (
                (
                  k.item_pointer + k.tuple_header + COALESCE(
                    CEIL(
                      (cs.nullable_columns + 7) / 8.0
                    ),
                    0
                  ) + COALESCE(cs.avg_data_width, 0)
                ) % k.maxalign
              )
            ),
            1
          )
        )
      )
    ) * k.block_size AS estimated_ideal_bytes
  FROM
    chunk_data cd
    CROSS JOIN constants k
    LEFT JOIN column_stats cs ON cs.schema = cd.chunk_schema
    AND cs.tbl = cd.chunk_name
),
/*
 * Aggregate physical chunks into logical hypertables.
 */
hypertable_estimates AS (
  SELECT
    schema,
    tbl,
    SUM(actual_heap_bytes) AS actual_heap_bytes,
    SUM(estimated_ideal_bytes) AS estimated_ideal_bytes,
    /*
     * For a hypertable, use the effective setting of the chunks.
     * In normal TimescaleDB usage these will be identical.
     */
    MAX(vacuum_scale_factor) AS vacuum_scale_factor,
    MAX(vacuum_threshold) AS vacuum_threshold,
    MAX(last_autovacuum) AS last_autovacuum,
    SUM(row_count) AS row_count
  FROM
    chunk_estimates
  GROUP BY
    schema,
    tbl
),
combined AS (
  SELECT
    schema,
    tbl,
    row_count,
    actual_heap_bytes,
    estimated_ideal_bytes,
    vacuum_scale_factor,
    vacuum_threshold,
    NULL :: timestamptz AS last_autovacuum
  FROM
    normal_estimates
  UNION
  ALL
  SELECT
    schema,
    tbl,
    row_count,
    actual_heap_bytes,
    estimated_ideal_bytes,
    vacuum_scale_factor,
    vacuum_threshold,
    last_autovacuum
  FROM
    hypertable_estimates
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    GREATEST(
      actual_heap_bytes - estimated_ideal_bytes,
      0
    ) AS estimated_bloat_bytes
  FROM
    combined
)
SELECT
  schema AS "Schema",
  tbl AS "Table",
  pg_size_pretty(actual_heap_bytes) AS "Actual heap size",
  pg_size_pretty(estimated_bloat_bytes) AS "Est. bloat",
  ROUND(
    100.0 * estimated_bloat_bytes / NULLIF(actual_heap_bytes, 0),
    2
  ) AS "Est. bloat %",
  ROUND(vacuum_scale_factor, 2) AS "Scale factor",
  ROUND(vacuum_threshold, 0) AS "Threshold",
  last_autovacuum AS "Last vacuum"
FROM
  final
ORDER BY
  estimated_bloat_bytes DESC

spec.title: Next anti-wraparound vacuum
spec.description: Minimum time until any table reaches its anti-wraparound VACUUM threshold - this is a function of the rate of transaction ID consumption and the autovacuum_freeze_max_age setting. Higher values are better.

spec.rawSql:
WITH current_stats AS (
  SELECT
    collected_at,
    xact_commit + xact_rollback AS total_transactions,
    LAG(xact_commit + xact_rollback, 144) OVER (
      ORDER BY
        collected_at
    ) AS transactions_24h_ago,
    LAG(collected_at, 144) OVER (
      ORDER BY
        collected_at
    ) AS collected_at_24h_ago
  FROM
    pganalyze.database_stats
),
params AS (
  SELECT
    (
      total_transactions - transactions_24h_ago
    ) :: numeric / NULLIF(
      EXTRACT(
        EPOCH
        FROM
          (
            collected_at - collected_at_24h_ago
          )
      ),
      0
    ) AS tx_per_sec,
    current_setting('autovacuum_freeze_max_age') :: bigint AS freeze_max_age,
    current_setting('autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age') :: bigint AS multixact_freeze_max_age
  FROM
    current_stats
  WHERE
    collected_at = (
      SELECT
        MAX(collected_at)
      FROM
        pganalyze.database_stats
    )
    AND transactions_24h_ago IS NOT NULL
),
tables AS (
  SELECT
    c.oid :: regclass :: text AS table_name,
    LEAST(
      p.freeze_max_age - age(c.relfrozenxid),
      p.multixact_freeze_max_age - mxid_age(c.relminmxid)
    ) AS tx_before_wraparound_vacuum
  FROM
    pg_class c
    CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE
    c.relfrozenxid != 0
    AND c.oid > 16384
),
minimum AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(tx_before_wraparound_vacuum) AS min_tx_before_wraparound
  FROM
    tables
)
SELECT
  min_tx_before_wraparound / NULLIF(p.tx_per_sec, 0) / 3600.0 AS min_hours_until_anti_wraparound_vacuum
FROM
  minimum
  CROSS JOIN params p;

spec.title: Transaction ID Allocation
spec.description: The rate of transaction IDs that are allocated per minute, as averaged over the last 24 hours. Higher allocation rates generally mean more freezing will be required.

spec.rawSql:
WITH samples AS (
    SELECT
        collected_at,
        xact_commit + xact_rollback AS total_transactions,
        LAG(xact_commit + xact_rollback, 144) OVER (
            ORDER BY collected_at
        ) AS transactions_24h_ago,
        LAG(collected_at, 144) OVER (
            ORDER BY collected_at
        ) AS collected_at_24h_ago
    FROM pganalyze.database_stats
)
SELECT
    collected_at AS time,
    ROUND(
        (
            total_transactions - transactions_24h_ago
        )::numeric
        /
        NULLIF(
            EXTRACT(
                EPOCH FROM (collected_at - collected_at_24h_ago)
            ) / 60.0,
            0
        ),
        2
    ) AS txn_per_minute_24h_avg
FROM samples
WHERE transactions_24h_ago IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY collected_at
